name: File history
description: Keeps earlier versions of your text files on this machine, every few minutes while they change, so a bad edit can be undone. Open a file's version history from its menu.

interval_min.label: Minutes between versions
interval_min.description: at most one version of a file is kept in this many minutes

keep_days.label: Days to keep versions
keep_days.description: how long earlier versions are kept on this machine
